text: both small and great: Heb. from small even unto great
put down: Heb. caused to cease. Heb. chemarim | Planets: Or, twelve signs or constellations
brake them down from thence: Or, ran from thence
the mount of corruption: that is, the mount of Olives
that he might not reign: Or, because he reigned | put the land to a tribute: Heb. set a mulct upon the land
